name: the browser-check script is not routed (back to the live server)
why: Without the route musicbrainz.org answers the script, sometimes with an HTML page; the stub's marker header is what tells the two apart even on a lucky run.

name: the stub is an empty script
why: An empty stub still stops the HTML parse error but leaves #unsupported-browser in the DOM, which the real page never has in a supported browser.
